### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. retinitis pigmentosa 12  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2343)

**Proposed mechanism:** CRB1 (HGNC:2343) —DISRUPTS→ Crumbs protein complex localization and function in photoreceptor outer segments (GO:0035936); Crumbs protein complex localization and function in photoreceptor outer segments (GO:0035936) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000479); Crumbs protein complex localization and function in photoreceptor outer segments (GO:0035936) —LEADS_TO→ Visual field defect (HP:0011007). Loss-of-function mutations in CRB1 disrupt the function of the Crumbs protein complex, which is essential for maintaining the structure of photoreceptor outer segments, ultimately leading to retinal degeneration and visual field defects in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic gain-of-function mutation in CRB1 associated with either disease would refute this hypothesis. _(variant: rs758645262)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CRB1 in these retinal dystrophies could lead to the development of targeted therapies for both conditions, potentially focusing on restoring the function of the Crumbs complex or mitigating downstream degenerative processes.
